entries.title: exampleFn throws on a negative input
entries.summary: exampleFn in src/example.ts rejects negative numbers; callers must clamp first.
entries.content: exampleFn validates its argument before incrementing. A negative input throws RangeError('negative input') instead of returning x + 1. The first attempt to call it from the parser passed raw offsets and failed the test suite; clamping with Math.max(0, x) at the call site fixed it.
